title: lsst-impostor-search: a Rubin/LSST search for supernova impostors and LBV eruptions
description: Python package and Rubin Science Platform notebook that search Rubin/LSST difference-imaging data (Data Preview 2 onward) for supernova impostor and luminous blue variable candidates in nearby galaxies, using DiaObject pre-selection, HECATE host association, and forced-photometry light-curve cuts.
